hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | { cmd=$(cat); [ -z "$cmd" ] && exit 0; H=hooks/universal/pre-tool/block-sealed-refs.sh; if [ ! -x "$H" ]; then echo "HOOK MISSING/NOT EXECUTABLE: $H -- failing closed" >&2; exit 2; fi; "$H" "$cmd"; }

jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | { cmd=$(cat); [ -z "$cmd" ] && exit 0; H=hooks/universal/pre-tool/deploy-gate.sh; if [ ! -x "$H" ]; then echo "HOOK MISSING/NOT EXECUTABLE: $H -- failing closed" >&2; exit 2; fi; "$H" "$cmd"; }
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; hooks/universal/post-tool/sync-lr-refined-date.sh "$f" || true; }
